terms: Pilot Edition: Pinoy Pages 2026–2027 (Category: Money & Business, Greater Toronto Area). The printed proof copy is released spring (April 16, 2027); the website is updated year-round.

Listings are Free, or Verified at $99 per year (CAD, plus applicable HST), with everything included. No add-ons, bundles or founding discounts in the pilot. Print ads are now booking for the 2026–2027 edition; rates on request.

Verified Kabayan badge: payment never buys the badge. Verified listings are only eligible; the badge is earned by four checks: a ~15-minute verification visit (kabayan-owned or run, really trading, ZCard completed) plus one mutual vouch from a verified business, confirmed by both. In the pilot, founding members are vouched for at the visit. We may withhold the badge if a check fails; the Verified listing continues without it.
Free listings are unverified: name and contact only, with no badge, no QR code, no Save contact button, no ZCard, and they can't give or receive vouches.
Keeping your badge — validity: the badge is valid for one year (12 months from the verification date). A light re-check at renewal updates the “Verified [date]”.
Keeping your badge — vouch: at least one mutual vouch must stay active. If a vouch is removed, you have a 60-day grace period to replace it; after that the badge is paused.
Keeping your badge — current details: contact details and the ZCard must stay current. A dead phone number or a closed business pauses the badge.
Keeping your badge — renewal: if you don't renew, the badge is removed and the listing drops to a Free listing.
Keeping your badge — complaints: a complaint pauses the badge pending review. Paused badges are not shown.
QR codes always resolve through pinoypages.ca. Our pages never ask for a login, a payment or personal information.
Website mirror: your online presence mirrors your print presence and is included free in every tier.
No guarantee of results: we report scan counts monthly (Verified). We do not promise any number of leads, calls, sales or visitors.

Printed edition: a short-run proof copy for advertisers (one copy per paid advertiser) and a sales brochure for prospects. It is not sold or handed out to the public. If it does not print, print ad fees are refunded.
Prices are in CAD, plus applicable HST. Draft terms, to be reviewed by a lawyer before launch.
